docs.doc: Implements real-time streaming of Annie's responses via Server-Sent Events. Defines files useStream.ts, streamClient.ts, and StreamingMessage.tsx.
Maps SSE event types to UI handlers: status->ThinkingIndicator, token->StreamingMessage, tool_call->ToolCallCard, done->finalize message, error->error toast.
GET /api/v1/stream/{conversation_id} returns SSE events with types: token, tool_call, tool_result, done, error. Requires Accept: text/event-stream header.
GET /api/stream/{conversation_id} streams LLM responses via SSE. Headers: Cache-Control: no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering: no.

file.reason: Backend SSE endpoint that web UI will connect to. Returns EventSourceResponse with events: status, token, tool_call, tool_result, done, error.
Formats status messages as SSE events. Web UI must parse this JSON structure.
Core streaming generator yielding SSE events. Defines event structure web UI must handle.
Chat endpoint that returns stream_url for SSE connection. ChatResponse model defines interface.
Request model for POST /api/chat - user_id, platform, message, context, files.
Response model with conversation_id, status, stream_url, timestamp.

constraints.constraint: Use EventSource API for SSE connections - no WebSocket or polling
Zustand for state management - lightweight, simple mental model
All SSE events wrapped in {event: "message", data: JSON.stringify({type, ...})}
Tool call/result display delegated to Story 20.8 - only emit events here
Use Jest with mock EventSource for hook testing
shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS for UI components
Exponential backoff: 1s initial, 30s max, reset on successful connection
No strict performance targets - Annie is a thinking machine
WCAG 2.1 Level AA - proper ARIA labels on streaming content

interfaces.interface: Returns text/event-stream with Cache-Control: no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering: no headers.
Status update from backend (e.g., "Annie is thinking...")
Text content chunk from LLM streaming response
Tool invocation event (delegate display to Story 20.8)
Tool execution result (delegate display to Story 20.8)
Stream completion event - finalize message and close connection
Error event with user-friendly message and error code

tests.standards: Use Jest with React Testing Library for component tests. For hooks, use @testing-library/react-hooks with mock EventSource. Integration tests should use real SSE connections to test backend. E2E tests use Playwright. Test pyramid: 60% unit, 30% integration, 10% E2E. Target 80%+ code coverage.
